messages.content:

For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. - Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.

output.fear: When I stood up and turned my light on, I saw the finger on my bed, but there was no one under it and no one else in my room but me. I felt a chill run down my spine.

output.disgust: When I stood up and turned my light on, I was repulsed to see that finger on my bed, but gratefully, there was no one under it or in my room but me.
